title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant
lede: Voyage Labs, led by former Google Maps product director and Uber product chief Manik Gupta, raised a $12 million seed round led by Kleiner Perkins for Atlas, a trip-planning agent in private beta.

points: SignalFire and SV Angel joined the round; the money goes to supplier partnerships and engineering hires.
Atlas stays with a trip from first idea to return home, researching each suggestion as it comes up.
Because it runs over weeks, it can tailor picks from long conversations, watch price changes and book flights and hotels.
The company is betting travel needs a dedicated product rather than a feature inside general assistants from frontier labs.

sections.text: CTO Yogesh Jain frames trip planning as a project with its own lifecycle, a good fit for long-running agents that keep state and act over days or weeks.
